metadata.description:
Version 2.0.0 reproducibility resources supporting Receiver Provenance, Population Selection, and Reliability Trade-offs in RSSI Localization.

The archive contains author-created code, derived data products, saved outputs, population/provenance records, validation and reliability analyses, and verification tools. It includes the post-rejection representation/population, fitting-validation, map-selection, portability, native reliability, DSI transfer, chronological LoRaWAN, post-hoc, and interface evidence.

Original Antwerp, DAE and DSI third-party source material remains under its respective source terms and is obtained separately where required for full reexecution.

Author-created software is MIT licensed; author-created documentation and derived non-code artifacts are CC BY 4.0 where indicated. Third-party materials are not relicensed by Paper A.
metadata.title: Receiver Provenance, Population Selection, and Reliability Trade-offs in RSSI Localization — Reproducibility Resources
